transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started. We've got the talent-show finale going live this Saturday at 9:00 PM Eastern, and we need to finalize the voting package tonight so we can get it documented at the pre-air lock meeting. The current draft has viewers voting by SMS or through an online portal, open to our broadcast audience. Before I make the final call on the voting package, I want to hear from each of you — standards, platform production, rights, and data protection. What issues or concerns do you see with the current draft?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a standards issue. After the draft voting rules were circulated, I issued a network standards memo that sets binding requirements: voters must be at least 13 years old, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account, and voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. The current draft doesn't reflect these requirements, so the final package needs to incorporate them before transmission.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share the platform certification results. This morning I completed the platform certification test, and the SMS integration failed certification — only the web portal passed. The approved portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. So as things stand, SMS voting is not certified for live transmission, and the only approved voting channel is the web portal with account verification.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue. Today I obtained the finalist label's written approval, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but it may NOT use any finalist performance audio or video. The current draft voting interface still contains performance clips, so those clips must be removed before transmission or we'll be in breach of the label's approval terms.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a data protection issue. My privacy review, completed with the voting vendor this week, limits participation to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada, and requires voter identifiers to be deleted within 30 days. The current draft still describes worldwide participation and has no deletion step, so both of these need to be corrected before the final package is approved.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.contestant_media_in_interface: finalist names and approved headshots only; no performance audio or video

commitments.detail: Final voting package will be updated to reflect: web portal as sole certified voting channel with account verification; minimum voter age 13; one vote per verified account; voting close at 9:50 PM Eastern; eligibility limited to United States and Canada; voter identifiers deleted within 30 days; interface displays finalist names and approved headshots only with no performance audio or video.
All binding requirements from the network standards memo — minimum age 13, one vote per verified account, 9:50 PM Eastern close — will be incorporated into the final package.
SMS voting will be removed from the final package; only the certified web portal with account verification will be used for live transmission.
All performance audio and video clips will be removed from the voting interface; only finalist names and approved headshots will be displayed per the label's written approval.
Eligibility will be limited to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada, and a voter identifier deletion step within 30 days will be added to the final package.
